1009: fn sync_action(
1010:     action: &SyncAction,
1011:     components: &BTreeMap<String, Component>,
1012:     warnings: &mut Vec<Value>,
1013: ) -> Result<SpecItem, CoreError> {
1014:     let params = action
1015:         .params
1016:         .iter()
1017:         .cloned()
1018:         .map(|param| resolve_alias_param(param, components))
1019:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
1020:     let mut items = Vec::new();
1021:     let mut fair_constituents = Vec::new();
1022:     for reference in &action.refs {
1023:         let component = components.get(&reference.alias).ok_or_else(|| CoreError {
1024:             message: format!("unknown alias '{}'", reference.alias),
1025:             line: action.span.start.line,
1026:             column: action.span.start.column,
1027:             origin: None,
1028:             name_resolution: false,
1029:         })?;
1030:         let source = component
1031:             .spec
1032:             .items
1033:             .iter()
1034:             .find(|item| matches!(item, SpecItem::Action { name, .. } if name == &reference.action))
1035:             .cloned()
1036:             .ok_or_else(|| CoreError {
1037:                 message: format!("unknown action '{}.{}'", reference.alias, reference.action),
1038:                 line: action.span.start.line,
1039:                 column: action.span.start.column,
1040:                 origin: None,
1041:                 name_resolution: false,
1042:             })?;
1043:         // Fairness is not inherited through synchronization (docs/LANGUAGE.md
1044:         // "Compose"): capture the constituent's own `fair` marker here, before
1045:         // `rewrite_component_item` and the composite's single `fair: action.fair`
1046:         // below discard it, so a non-fair composite that references a fair
1047:         // constituent can be reported.
1048:         if matches!(&source, SpecItem::Action { fair: true, .. }) {
1049:             fair_constituents.push(format!("{}.{}", reference.alias, reference.action));
1050:         }
1051:         let SpecItem::Action {
1052:             params: source_params,
1053:             items: source_items,
1054:             ..
1055:         } = rewrite_component_item(source, component)
1056:         else {
1057:             unreachable!()
1058:         };
1059:         if source_params.len() != reference.args.len() {
1060:             return Err(error_at(
1061:                 format!(
1062:                     "sync reference '{}.{}' expects {} argument(s), got {}",
1063:                     reference.alias,
1064:                     reference.action,
1065:                     source_params.len(),
1066:                     reference.args.len()
1067:                 ),
1068:                 action.span,
1069:             ));
1070:         }
1071:         let replacements = source_params
1072:             .iter()
1073:             .zip(&reference.args)
1074:             .map(|(param, arg)| {
1075:                 let name = match param {
1076:                     Param::Typed(name, _) | Param::Range(name, _, _) => name.clone(),
1077:                 };
1078:                 Ok((name, resolve_alias_expr(arg.clone(), components)?))
1079:             })
1080:             .collect::<Result<HashMap<_, _>, CoreError>>()?;
1081:         items.extend(
1082:             source_items
1083:                 .into_iter()
1084:                 .map(|item| substitute_action_item(item, &replacements)),
1085:         );
1086:     }
1087:     items.extend(
1088:         action
1089:             .items
1090:             .iter()
1091:             .cloned()
1092:             .map(|item| resolve_alias_action_item(item, components))
1093:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
1094:     );
1095:     if !action.fair && !fair_constituents.is_empty() {
1096:         let refs = fair_constituents.join(", ");
1097:         warnings.push(json!({
1098:             "kind": "fair_not_inherited",
1099:             "message": format!(
1100:                 "synchronized action '{}' is not fair; fair constituent action(s) {refs} will not contribute fairness unless the composite action is declared fair",
1101:                 action.name,
1102:             ),
1103:             "loc": action.span.python_loc(),
1104:         }));
1105:     }
1106:     Ok(SpecItem::Action {
1107:         name: action.name.clone(),
1108:         params,
1109:         items,
1110:         span: action.span,
1111:         fair: action.fair,
1112:         meta: action.meta.clone(),
1113:         sync: true,
1114:         annotations: action.annotations.clone(),
1115:     })
1116: }
